question: Does training the latent route (system i -> packet -> system 0) on 65 arm keys (about 33 distinct kinematics: v6's 13 plus 52 procedural / menagerie arms) improve zero-shot and small-budget transfer to NEW arms (kinova gen3, flexiv rizon4, two sealed procedural arms; xarm7 REUSED) relative to the v6 13-body lineages and to direct-action BC on the same data (H1, D-137)?

tier_notes.tertiary_reused: xarm7 sealed scenes were already looked at in D-135 / D-136: reported separately, never pooled into the primary claim

methods.zero_shot: deployed latent route, no target data (budget 0)
methods.flow_sft: system-i flow SFT on b target demos (system 0 frozen); updates {5:150,20:300,100:600}, lr 1e-4
methods.system0_refit: system-0 realizer refit on b target demos (flow frozen), same updates / lr
methods.joint_adapt: flow + system 0 at the SAME total update count, gen_frac 0.5 (D-136)
methods.bc_sft: direct-action BC (bcv7div expert family, same pack, same input information) SFT on the same b demos, same updates / lr / episode choice
methods.v6_reference: the v6 13-body lineages and the v6 BC expert evaluated on the same targets with the same protocol (no new training; reported as existing-controller transfer)

reading_rules.unit: success rate over the 100 sealed scenes per (target, method, budget, seed); infeasible scenes excluded and counted; Wilson 95% intervals
reading_rules.primary_contrast: latent_sem (v8div) minus v6 latent_sem, zero-shot and adapted, per PRIMARY-tier target; a difference counts only when the 95% intervals of both cells are disjoint or the paired-seed difference has the same sign in every lineage seed
reading_rules.vs_bc: latent (best of flow_sft / system0_refit / joint_adapt, chosen on nothing but the protocol: all three are reported) vs bc_sft at equal budget and equal update count
reading_rules.no_pooling: tiers are never pooled; tertiary (xarm7) is reported as REUSED
reading_rules.sealed_once: each sealed cell runs once; a failed cell is reported as failed, not re-run with changed settings
reading_rules.kinfeat: the kinfeat ablation is reported only if its BC expert was trained with the same inputs

latency.condition: no other GPU lease active on the peer

dev_rule: development iteration only on source bodies and dev scenes (>=3,000,000); targets / eval scenes untouched until the sealed runs; target demos come from seeds 1,000,000+
notes: Sealed guards read rrp.bodies.armdiv (is_sealed_target); the armdiv targets and the family prefixes gen3_ / rizon4_ / iiwa14_ / pa2s>=900000 never enter training or dev evaluation. Pre-registered in research/tracks/armdiv.md (G4 entry) before any v8div training.
